snippet.title: HiddenBunker
snippet.description:
🏔️ Welcome to Hidden Bunker — every build starts as one question in my head: how do you make somewhere livable that was never meant to be?

⛏️ I design each shelter from scratch before a single beam goes in — the engineering, the materials for that project's climate, the layout, the furniture, even how the story ends.

🔨 Every video follows that idea from the first mark on untouched ground to a fully furnished hideaway: breaking ground, framing, insulation, wiring, finishing, furnishing.

❄️ Whether it's anchored to a cliff-edge rock or carved deep into a mountainside, each build tells its own story of engineering, design, and resilience.

🎥 New builds regularly. Subscribe and follow the journey from bare ground to finished home.
🔔 Turn on notifications so you never miss the next one.

snippet.title: The Hidden Drawer
snippet.description:
Every home has a drawer.
You know the one — stuffed with odd bits, half-forgotten tools, and little things that somehow fix everything. That's the idea behind this channel.
The Hidden Drawer is a collection of overlooked hacks, clever shortcuts, and low-cost fixes that most people never learn. The kind of knowledge your grandfather knew, your neighbor keeps to himself, and big brands hope you never stumble across.
Here, it all comes out of hiding.
One video might show you a $1 household fix. The next, a kitchen shortcut that saves an hour. Then a car trick most drivers never hear about, a home repair that skips the handyman bill, or an off-grid method worth remembering.
No filler. No fluff. Real problems, real solutions, step by step.
A new video slides open every week.
Subscribe — and see what's been sitting in the drawer all along.

snippet.title: ON Three
snippet.description:
My background is in Strength and Conditioning. I have trained Navy SEALs and Division 1 Collegiate athletes. 
I’ve been hunting, fishing, camping, and practicing bushcraft/survival skills all of my life and I’m fascinated by our ancient ancestors and their ability to thrive off the landscape.
I love challenging myself and jump at each and every chance to test my skills, strength and stamina. 
There is a relentless hard-to-reach “itch” and it seems the only way to scratch it is with a good adventure. So……. Let’s go on 3!

I like to say “What’s the worst that can happen?”

@jasonleesurvival

snippet.title: My Adventure To Fit
snippet.description:
Welcome to My Adventure to Fit! 🎉

Join me, Tiffany, on a journey that reveals the real, unfiltered truth about weight loss, fitness, and health. We cover the good, the bad, and everything in between. From battling cravings to celebrating victories, our community is all about honesty and support.

🌟 What to Expect:

Authentic weight loss stories
Effective fitness tips
Delicious, healthy recipes
Honest product reviews
Updates on my journey, including my current pregnancy!
I'm currently embracing a new adventure – pregnancy – and sharing how I stay healthy during this exciting time. Expect special pregnancy-related content, tips, and updates.

Whether you're here to lose weight, improve fitness, or find inspiration, My Adventure to Fit is your go-to channel for motivation and truth. Let's navigate this journey together, supporting each other every step of the way.

Check out our latest shorts and videos! Your engagement and feedback mean the world to me. 💕
